summary: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe for the optical-connectivity-to-epitaxy-tools node. The cleanest US-listed exposure appears split across two lanes: reference leaders in optical components and lasers, and underfollowed or less-obvious chokepoint names in silicon photonics foundry capacity and compound-semiconductor substrates. This pass keeps the list to four names: COHR and LITE as obvious laser/optical-component read-throughs; TSEM as a silicon-photonics foundry capacity candidate; and AXTI as a more obscure compound-semiconductor substrate candidate tied to InP/GaAs supply. Claims about AI-driven optical demand are treated as inference unless directly supported by company contracts, filings, or customer disclosures.
